hero.title: Give AI-built applications a governed home.
hero.description: Employees across the business already build working applications with AI coding tools — most of them outside engineering. Those applications will run somewhere. This site sets out why that needs a governed home, what a platform has to do about it, and where to read the detail.

whys.title: A prototype creates potential. A governed application creates value.
whys.body: A durable business application is company-owned, securely connected, reliably operated, observable, and transferable. Without those properties, more creation means more unsupported software, unmanaged access, and hidden cost.

whys.title: Citizen developers will host their applications. The question is where.
whys.body: Employees across the business already create applications with AI coding tools. Without an approved route to production, useful applications remain prototypes, wait for central IT, or move to personal accounts and public services.

whys.title: One platform turns citizen development into a governed operating model.
whys.body: Vercel gives builders a direct route to production while administrators retain ownership, visibility, and control. Across the six lifecycle stages tested with the the company team, Vercel is the only end-to-end fit.
